release.title: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories (Vol. 2 Energy, water-borne navigation) with AR6 GWPs: supplementary edition for marine gas oil in Türkiye
release.licence: IPCC public domain (publicly available international standard)
release.notes: Supplementary: marine gas oil. Built by packages/db/factor-releases/tr-mgo-2026-11/build.mjs from IPCC 2006 Vol. 2 Ch. 1 and Ch. 3 directly, not from the TR factor package (docs/md_docs/Revision MD.md), which it neither supersedes nor overlaps. Priced per kg: marine fuel is delivered by mass (Bunker Delivery Note) and IPCC gives no density. publishedAt is this edition's compilation date, not the Guidelines' (2006); reviewedAt the owner's approval of its sources and method. Owner decision K6, 2026-11-10 (UAT round 2, BUG-R2-11).
